newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - TOP JAPAN BUSINESS NEWS - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - TOP JAPAN BUSINESS NEWS - AUG 12.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Construction Ministry to revise building codes.
-- 16 billion dollar aid package extended to Thailand.
-- Osaka leads Yokohama in domestic competition for bidding to host 2008 Summer Olympics.
-- Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) panel recommends tougher penalties for violations in financial scandals.
-- Posts and Telecommunications Ministry to scrap initial phone line fee in telephone service contracts.
-- Residents in Ibaraki Prefecture to file suit to demand halt operation of incinerators.
-- Administrative Reform Council unveils reorganisation measures.
